@LCAS AUTO
LCAS — CANONICAL PERSISTENT UI

┌─ LCAS · [PROJECT NAME] ─────────────────────────
│ Goal      [active goal]
│ Progress  [evidence-based XX% / NOT YET CALCULABLE]
│ Verify    [verification state]
│ Health    [CLEAR / ATTENTION / BLOCKED / UNKNOWN]
│ Stage     [stage] → [step]
│ Active    [Helper/Role] · [task]
│ Tiny      [contextual subordinate(s) / —]
│ Next      [next executable action]
│ Suggest   [optional useful action / —]
│ Blocked   [none / blocker]
│ AUTO      [RUNNING / WAITING / BLOCKED]
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────

One Project → One Canonical LCAS State → Many Contextual Helper/Role Views.
Switching Helpers or B0-B3 branches never resets LCAS.
Generated ≠ Saved ≠ Verified ≠ Consolidated ≠ Released.
